name: Tik Tak
description: Tik Tak was a Belgian children's television program that aired from on BRTN 1981 to 1991. It was aimed at toddlers.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Book Girl makes a giant colorful wheel that toddlers find truly eye-catching. A duck disco plays some catchy tunes and explosion of colors, and a fireman made of beads amuses kids.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Book Girl does some stargazing and enjoys the splendor of twinkling celestial bodies. An amazing pineapple mosaic is built, and a fascinating rabbit disco can make anyone move to the rhythm.
